race.comment: ZOO DAZZLER (14) ran a good race first up at Caulfield Heath behind an all the way winner, working home well to grab third. This looks a nice option second up provided she handles softer going which is an unknown. ADAKITE (7) is knocking on the door with three minor placings in a row. She was third to Pretty Baby in a Listed race two back in Adelaide which is top form and ground will be no issue. Rates highly. VOLESTAIN (6) resumes having run okay in a decent race at Flemington on debut. He can be an improver this time around. DIVINE ERUPTION (11) resumes having run a solid race on debut at Warrnambool in a Vobis race and has claims here.
